set -euo pipefail
BRANCH=integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
EXPECTED=3b331791d6ea2a372f42dd4cb3746af26441cd29
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$EXPECTED"
git checkout -B "$BRANCH" "$EXPECTED"
git reset --hard "$EXPECTED"
. ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
roots=[Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include'),Path('managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include')]
for root in roots:
    if not root.exists():
        continue
    for rel in ['ezbee/zcl/cluster/ias_zone.h','ezbee/zcl/cluster/ias_zone_desc.h','compat/zcl/esp_zigbee_zcl_ias_zone.h','compat/zcl/esp_zigbee_zcl_command.h']:
        p=root/rel
        if not p.exists():
            continue
        print('===',p,'===')
        lines=p.read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines()
        for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
            low=line.lower()
            if ('restore' in low or 'zone status change' in low or 'zone_status_change' in low or 'status_change_notif' in low or 'zonestatus' in low) and i < 350:
                lo=max(1,i-4); hi=min(len(lines),i+8)
                for n in range(lo,hi+1): print(f'{n}: {lines[n-1]}')
                print()
print('=== LOCAL EXAMPLES / SOURCES USING RESTORE_NOTIFY ===')
for base in [Path('.'),Path.home()/'esp',Path.home()/'.espressif']:
    if not base.exists(): continue
    count=0
    for p in base.rglob('*'):
        if count>=120: break
        if not p.is_file() or p.suffix.lower() not in {'.c','.h','.cpp','.cc','.md','.rst','.txt'}: continue
        try: text=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
        except Exception: continue
        if 'RESTORE_NOTIFY' in text or 'ZONE_STATUS_RESTORE' in text or 'restore reports' in text.lower():
            for i,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1):
                if 'RESTORE_NOTIFY' in line or 'ZONE_STATUS_RESTORE' in line or 'restore reports' in line.lower():
                    print(f'{p}:{i}:{line.strip()}'); count+=1
                    if count>=120: break
print('=== DECISION REQUIRED ===')
print('State whether the IAS ZoneStatus RestoreNotify bit 0x0020 is the standards-defined capability controlling clear/restore notifications. Given v15 receives 0x0001 repeatedly but never 0x0000, decide whether emulator normal/alarm values should be 0x0020/0x0021 (preserving RestoreNotify while toggling Alarm1). Cite exact local header/source evidence. State smallest code change only; do not edit files or touch hardware.')
PY
git status --short
